31924-IV.s: This bill amends the 2008 departmental budget statement for Kingdom Relations (IV) and the budget statement for businesses operating on an accrual basis, setting the figures in thousands of euros and making the changes effective retroactively to 31 December of the budget year. The explanatory memorandum excerpt reports lower-than-budgeted spending and commitments on several articles, including coast guard and air surveillance capacity and the autonomy programmes.
q: Commitments of € 4.3 million less were entered into.
Er is voor € 4,3 miljoen minder verplichtingen aangegaan.

31924-VI.s: This bill amends the 2008 departmental budget (Slotwet) of the Ministry of Justice and the budget for its agency services, setting the adjusted amounts in thousands of euros and making the changes retroactive to 31 December 2008. The explanatory memorandum explains budget variances such as higher commitments for terrorism-prevention camera surveillance subsidies and shortfalls in fine and transaction revenues.
q: Finally, a project was set up in 2007 to improve the quality of archive management at the Notariat.
Ten slotte is ter verbetering van de kwaliteit van het archiefbeheer bij het Notariaat in 2007 een project opgesteld.

31999.s: The bill freezes the amounts of child benefit and the income-dependent child budget for 2010 and 2011 by suspending indexation, and adjusts income thresholds and other amounts in the Wet kindgebonden budget. It also adjusts the Algemene Kinderbijslagwet so that the benefit amounts are not revised in 2010 and 2011.
31999.j: The memorandum justifies the non-indexation as a means of controlling spending on child benefit and the child budget, and notes that a further increase could be arranged by general administrative order.
q: in connection with controlling expenditure on child benefit and the child-related budget, the amounts for child benefit and the child-related budget are not to be indexed in 2010 and 2011
in verband met de beheersing van de uitgaven aan kinderbijslag en kindgebonden budget de bedragen voor de kinderbijslag en het kindgebonden budget niet te indexeren in de jaren 2010 en 2011

parties: Accepts the need for measures but asks for clarity on WTOS integration, the omitted increase for second and third children, and a clearer income-effects overview.
They acknowledge (partly given the current economic situation) the need to take some measures, all the more so since these follow from the savings target already included in the 2009 budget.

Zij erkennen (mede gelet op de huidige economische situatie) de noodzaak tot het treffen van enkele maatregelen, temeer daar deze voortvloeien uit de taakstelling die al was opgenomen in de begroting 2009.
Accepts that savings are needed but asks for concrete financial effects and protection of lower incomes, with detailed household examples.
These members accept that cuts must be made but want more clarity on the concrete financial consequences of this proposal for the families affected.
Deze leden onderkennen dat er bezuinigingen doorgevoerd moeten worden maar willen meer duidelijkheid over de concrete financiële gevolgen van dit voorstel voor de gezinnen die het treft.
Opposes cutting child benefit during the crisis, questions the 20% reduction for older children, and asks why income-dependent child benefit is not used instead.
To fight the economic crisis the government chooses to harm precisely that group, namely the children, who had no influence on that same crisis.
Om de economische crisis te bestrijden kiest de regering ervoor juist die groep te duperen, namelijk de kinderen, die geen enkele invloed hebben gehad op diezelfde crisis.
Questions the justification for reducing the child-related budget increase and asks for effects by household composition, poverty and single-parent families.
They particularly raise questions about the effects on different household compositions and the choice of measures.
Zij stellen met name vragen bij de effecten op verschillende gezinssamenstellingen en de keuze voor maatregelen.
Asks why the measures were not handled together earlier, whether alternatives existed, and how they relate to childcare allowance changes.
Why within the Youth and Family budget are cuts made precisely to the direct financial support of families, even though this is so important for families, ask these members.
Waarom wordt binnen de begroting voor Jeugd en Gezin juist bezuinigd op de directe financiële ondersteuning van gezinnen, terwijl dit voor gezinnen zo belangrijk is, zo vragen genoemde leden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the explanatory memorandum should clarify, in light of its income-effects graph, what is meant by the statement that low incomes will be spared as much as possible. The government adopted the advice by revising the income-effects section and replacing the graph.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should explain how the statement that low incomes are protected should be understood given the income-effects graph.

32500-VII.s: This bill establishes the 2011 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (Chapter VII) and the operating budgets of seven baten-lastendiensten (business-operations services) under that ministry. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force on 1 January 2011 or the day after publication if published later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) belonging to this act for the year 2011 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2011 wordt vastgesteld.

33090-IXB.s: This bill amends the 2011 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB), adjusting appropriations and revenues in line with the autumn budget memorandum (Najaarsnota). It also sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date as 1 December 2011.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2011 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2011 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33400-VII.s: The bill sets the 2013 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII), including policy articles and the budgets of nine baten-lastendiensten, and fixes amounts in thousands of euros. It is a budget law with no delegation of rule-making power to the executive, and the explanatory memorandum is a policy and budget report rather than a justification of new powers.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2013 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2013 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that a budget-splitting amendment (nota van wijziging) cannot serve as a standalone bill to create a separate budget for the minister for Housing and Civil Service in 2013, because the constitutional procedure was not followed and the removed appropriations would be left without authorisation. The government's reply accepts the advice, withdraws the separate-bill route, and proposes a second amendment creating a separate budget schedule within the BZK budget act for 2013 only.
concerns: A nota van wijziging cannot be used to split a pending bill into a separate budget bill, since the constitution provides for splitting only in constitutional revision procedures.
Removing appropriations from the BZK budget without a new budget authorisation would leave the minister for Housing and Civil Service without any spending authority for 2013.
The advice notes the Eerste Kamer lacks initiative and amendment rights, underscoring the need to respect the regular legislative procedure.

33799.s: The bill gives police officers the power to order a suspect held for a violent offence to undergo breath, saliva, or psychomotor tests for alcohol or drug use, with blood tests on prosecutor or deputy-prosecutor authorisation. The results are meant to inform sentencing by prosecutors and judges.
33799.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to objectively establish drug or alcohol use in violent offences so prosecutors and judges can factor it into sentencing, and says the tests are limited to violent offences and proportionate.
q: The bill introduces a statutory power for investigating officers to order a suspect of a violent offence to cooperate with an examination of alcohol or drug use.

Het wetsvoorstel introduceert een wettelijke bevoegdheid voor opsporingsambtenaren om een verdachte van een geweldsmisdrijf te bevelen mee te werken aan een onderzoek naar het gebruik van alcohol of drugs.
d: designation of drugs and rules on conducting saliva and psychomotor tests
rules on conducting breath and blood tests, including counter-examination
p: Police officers may order arrested suspects of violent offences to submit to alcohol and drug tests that intrude on bodily integrity, on a suspicion of intoxication.
Prosecutors and, when they cannot be awaited, deputy prosecutors may order blood tests on suspects, with medical exemptions and rules set by general administrative order.

parties: Supports tougher sentences for violence under the influence and sees the test as an objective tool, emphasising personal responsibility.
They are in favour of the possibility of increasing sentences for suspects of violent offences committed under the influence of substances.
Zij zijn voorstander van de mogelijkheid tot verzwaring van straffen ten aanzien van verdachten van geweldsdelicten onder invloed van middelen.
Agrees with the aim but asks how intoxication can be weighed in sentencing when no test was carried out, and about practical application in mass disorder.
They share the government's view that alcohol or drug use can contribute to violence and that action should be taken against it.
Zij delen de opvatting van de regering dat het gebruik van alcohol of drugs kan bijdragen aan het plegen van geweld en dat daartegen moet worden opgetreden.
Questions the title and effectiveness, doubts officers can judge the effect of substances on the suspect, and raises concerns about automatic sentence increases and handling of blood samples.
Does the government consider the title of this act appropriate for this bill?
Vindt de regering dat de titel van deze wet passend is bij dit wetsvoorstel?
Asks about the composition and findings of the NFI expert group, threshold evidence, drug types covered, and who pays for counter-testing.
The aforementioned members ask who bears the cost of a counter-examination if a suspect requests one under the proposed Article 56a(6).
Voornoemde leden vragen voor wie de kosten zijn van een tegenonderzoek indien een verdachte dit instelt op grond van het voorgestelde artikel 56a zesde lid?
Supports the aim and prevention, cites research showing the alcohol-aggression link is conditional, and asks why certain offences and the thresholds were excluded or chosen.
They do, however, draw attention to scientific research that nuances the government's position on the relationship with aggression.
Wel vragen zij aandacht voor wetenschappelijk onderzoek dat de stellingname van de regering ten aanzien van de relatie met agressie nuanceert.
Doubts effectiveness, asks for baseline data and evaluation, questions the threshold values and the breadth of the offence criterion, and the added value over current sentencing practice.
These members endorse the aim of reducing substance-related violence in public and domestic settings, but they have doubts about the effectiveness of the proposed measures.

Deze leden onderstrepen het doel om middelengerelateerd geweld in het openbare leven en in de huiselijke kring terug te dringen, maar ze hebben twijfels over de effectiviteit van de voorgestelde maatregelen.
Supports taking intoxication into account but questions whether a threshold avoids an automatic effect, given the complex link with aggression and the Public Prosecution Service's objections.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a draft bill to combat violence under the influence of alcohol and drugs by introducing a mandatory intoxication test in the Code of Criminal Procedure. It questioned the necessity, added value, causal link and preventive effect of the test, and recommended reconsideration, while the government's reply largely disagreed but adopted several points (drafting clarifications, minimum thresholds, scope adjustments).
concerns: The Afdeling found the necessity and added value of the intoxication test insufficiently demonstrated relative to existing sentencing practice; the government argued the test makes intoxication visible in court and adopted minimum thresholds but disagreed on the rest.

The Afdeling held that treating intoxication in general as an automatic aggravating factor is not appropriate given complex correlations; the government adopted expert-advised lower thresholds and clarified the paragraph.

The test infringes bodily integrity (Art. 11 Constitution) and privacy (Art. 8 ECHR), requiring careful justification of necessity and proportionality, which the government considered adequately addressed.
Doubts about the claimed preventive effect; the government announced a public information campaign and clarified the memorandum on this point.
The criterion 'onderzoeksbelang' is broader than the explanatory memorandum suggests and lacks a causal test; the government added a condition but did not fully align the text with the commentary.
The criterion 'misdrijf gericht tegen de onaantastbaarheid van het lichaam' is not a settled concept and may be hard for officers to apply; the government considered it workable.
Application outside flagrante delicto raises difficulty in establishing causality over time; the Afdeling advised limiting the test to caught-in-the-act cases, which the government declined.
Redactional remark on the cross-reference in article 56a(3) Sv, adopted by the government.

33805-IV.s: The bill amends the 2013 budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, adjusting appropriations for the guarantee function and for strengthening the autonomy of Kingdom partners, with effect from 1 December 2013. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no shift of power to the executive; it is a budgetary adjustment.
q: The budget statement Kingdom Relations for the year 2013 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat Koninkrijksrelaties voor het jaar 2013 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33805-VI.s: This bill amends the 2013 budget statements of the Ministry of Security and Justice (second supplementary budget), adjusting spending and revenue across policy articles such as police, judiciary, sanctions and youth. It sets the amended budget in thousands of euros and fixes its entry into force from 1 December 2013.
33805-VI.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by higher-than-expected inflows of fines and transaction revenue and by cost overruns in various programmes, without any delegation of new powers.
q: Due to a higher-than-expected inflow, a windfall in fines and transaction revenue of €80 million is expected for 2013.
Door een hoger dan verwachte instroom, wordt voor 2013 een meevaller bij boeten- en transactieontvangsten verwacht van € 80 mln.

33889.s: The bill amends the Wet algemene regels herindeling to set general rules on the consequences of municipal boundary changes for council elections, including who prepares interim elections and how council terms are extended or shortened around a merger date. It also revokes twelve earlier ad hoc laws that extended council terms for specific municipalities.
33889.j: The memorandum justifies the uniform term-extension rules by the need to give newly merged municipalities time to organise and by the constitutional requirement that deviations from the four-year term be set by statute, not delegated to municipalities.
q: The deviation from the four-year council term was entrusted by the constitutional legislator to the legislature and, given the terminology used in the Constitution, cannot be delegated to the municipalities.
De afwijking van de zittingsduur van 4 jaar is door de grondwetgever opgedragen aan de wetgever en kan gelet op de gehanteerde terminologie in de Grondwet niet aan de gemeenten worden gedelegeerd.

parties: Welcomes a general structural rule and accepts the six-year-three-month term for the first council after a mid-term reorganisation to avoid three elections in four years.
The VVD members can therefore agree with the chosen solution.
De leden van de VVD-fractie kunnen zich dan ook vinden in de gekozen oplossing.
Asks whether the government considered extending the sitting council's term by one year and nine months instead, and how it views that alternative.

Has the government also considered extending the term of the sitting council by one year and nine months if the intention to change municipal boundaries is already known before the regular council elections?

Heeft de regering ook overwogen om – indien het voornemen om over te gaan tot een wijziging van de gemeentelijke indeling reeds bekend is voordat de reguliere raadsverkiezingen plaatsvinden – de zittingsduur van de zittende raad met één jaar en negen maanden te verlengen?
Agrees that giving statutory anchoring to current practice creates clarity for municipalities, and asks when proposals flowing from the 2011 evaluation of the Wet arhi will be submitted.
They share the government's starting point that this gives more clarity to municipalities involved in a reorganisation procedure by giving statutory anchoring to current practice.

Zij delen het uitgangspunt van de regering, dat op deze wijze meer helderheid wordt verschaft aan gemeenten die betrokken zijn in een procedure voor herindeling, door de huidige praktijk een wettelijke verankering te geven.
Notes disadvantages of the extended term after mid-term reorganisations and asks whether policy will be pursued to limit such mid-term reorganisations.
To prevent such disadvantages, the members ask whether policy will be pursued to limit municipal reorganisations in the middle of the council term as much as possible.

Om dergelijke nadelen te voorkomen vragen de aan het woord zijnde leden zich af of er beleid gevoerd gaat worden teneinde gemeentelijke herindelingen halverwege de raadsperiode zoveel mogelijk te beperken.
Supports the structural rule but asks whether two elections within one year can occur and how municipalities and parties will be informed about possibly longer candidate lists.
There is rightly attention for the risk of lists being underused if they apply for five or even six years.
Er is terecht aandacht voor het risico dat er onderuitputting van de lijsten op kan treden als de lijsten voor vijf of zelfs zes jaar gelden.

33940-IV.s: This bill amends the 2014 budget statement for Kingdom Relations (first supplementary budget), mainly reshuffling funds between articles and reclassifying the coast guard and border surveillance line items. The explanatory memorandum says the extra money is for the constitutional evaluation of Caribbean Netherlands, settlement of cooperation funds, and strengthened financial management.
q: Structurally, financial supervision and coordination of Caribbean Netherlands are being intensified.
Structureel wordt er geïntensiveerd op het financieel toezicht en de coördinatie van Caribisch Nederland.

33940-VI.s: This bill amends the 2014 departmental budget of the Ministry of Security and Justice (first supplementary budget), adjusting spending and revenue across policy articles such as police, legal aid, judiciary, and sanctions. It also adjusts the budget of the joint ICT service agency, and takes effect from 1 June 2014.
q: Whereas We have considered that a need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice for 2014
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie (VI) voor het jaar 2014

33979.s: The bill bans dairy cattle farmers from producing phosphate from dairy cattle in a calendar year, except where listed exemptions apply, following the end of EU milk quotas on 1 April 2015. It introduces a phosphate reference for each dairy farm, sets administrative fines per kilogram of excess phosphate, and caps pig and poultry numbers per farm.
33979.j: The memorandum justifies the new production ban and delegated rules by the end of EU milk quotas and the need for responsible growth of dairy farming while limiting manure surpluses.
d: Artikel 21, tweede lid, onderdeel d, sub 2 and 3
categories of farmers and buyers, distance from border and conditions for spreading manure abroad
Artikel 21, tweede lid, onderdeel d, sub 4
conditions for direct transfer of manure to nearby farms
Artikel 21, tweede lid, onderdeel d, sub 5
animal categories and housing systems exempt from the ban
date for determining natural terrain in use by the farm
classification of dairy and young cattle categories
p: Artikel 21, tweede lid, onderdeel d, sub 5
Executive may designate by general administrative order which animal categories and housing systems are exempt from the production ban.
Minister issues a non-transferable-by-default phosphate reference per farm, with calculation rules set by delegated regulation, determining farmers' production rights.
Introduces administrative fines of 11 euro per kilogram of unlawfully produced phosphate, capped by criminal law fine categories.

parties: Asks how the bill affects entrepreneurial freedom, the derogation process with Brussels, sector capacity and the cumulative burden on dairy farms.
The VVD members conclude that this bill once again increases burdens on the dairy sector.
De leden van de VVD-fractie concluderen dat deze wet wederom zorgt voor een toename van lasten voor de melkveehouderij.
Worries that allowing expansion with processed manure creates market pressure and that phosphate steering only works after the ceiling is already exceeded; asks for stricter conditions.
The PvdA members ask the government to amend the scheme and allow expansion only when enough land is under the farm to place the extra phosphate production in full.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie verzoeken de regering om de regeling aan te passen en alleen uitbreiding toe te staan wanneer er voldoende grond onder het bedrijf ligt om extra fosfaatproductie die het gevolg is van uitbreiding in zijn geheel te plaatsen.
Says the bill ends grass-bound dairy and opens the door to landless mega-stables; asks for regulation through animal permits and questions how the ceiling is enforced.
These members see the grass-bound character of the dairy sector being abandoned, with the door wide open to mega-stables of milk cows without land, where animals are permanently housed.

Deze leden zien dat het grondgebonden karakter van de melkveesector losgelaten wordt, en de deur wagenwijd openstaat voor megastallen met melkkoeien, zonder grond, waarbij de dieren permanent op stal staan.

Asks on what criteria and when the phosphate balance is assessed, whether the bill lets fast-growing manure-processing farms outpace land-based farms, and what happens if instruments prove insufficient.

Is the government aware that this bill makes it possible for an entrepreneur who already has a phosphate surplus to grow quickly with manure processing, while a dairy farmer who still has land and manure placement space may be limited in gradual growth by the phosphate ceiling?

Is de regering zich ervan bewust dat onderhavige wetswijzigingsvoorstel het mogelijk maakt dat een ondernemer die nu al een fosfaatoverschot heeft snel door kan groeien met mestverwerking terwijl een melkveehouder die nog grond en mestplaatsingsruimte op zijn eigen bedrijf of in de nabije omgeving heeft, in zijn geleidelijke groei beperkt kan worden vanwege het fosfaatplafond?
Objects that the option of 100% manure processing allows unchecked growth and that phosphate steering can only act after the ceiling is breached; urges grass-bound growth.
The D66 members note with disappointment that this bill creates the possibility to opt for 100% processing when growing.
De leden van de D66-fractie constateren met teleurstelling dat in dit wetsvoorstel de mogelijkheid gecreëerd wordt om voor 100% verwerking te kiezen bij groei.
Missing a clear objective and concern that the bill favours manure processing over grass-bound growth; asks whether growth without land should be allowed.
They have concerns about the direction the dairy sector will take through this bill, which seems mainly focused on manure processing.
Genoemde leden hebben zorgen over de richting die de melkveehouderij door dit wetsvoorstel zal inslaan, waarbij vooral lijkt te worden ingezet op mestverwerking.

Welcomes obligations on expanding farms but questions whether the phosphate ceiling is adequately anticipated; prefers avoiding animal rights and asks about generic measures hitting non-expanding farms.
The SGP members find it positive that dairy farms that expand and enlarge the manure surplus are obliged to take measures.
Zij vinden het positief dat melkveebedrijven die uitbreiden en het mestoverschot groter maken verplicht worden om maatregelen te nemen.
Argues the bill turns dairy into industrial agriculture with animals permanently indoors and growth beyond national environmental limits; calls for milk quota-style animal rights now.
They note that the government puts no obstacle in the way of dairy farming growing further, transforming into a new form of bio-industry and letting the already gigantic manure surplus grow further.

Zij constateren dat de regering de melkveehouderij geen strobreed in de weg legt om nog verder te groeien, zich om te vormen tot een nieuwe vorm van bioindustrie en het toch al gigantische mestoverschot nog verder te laten groeien.

33988.s: This omnibus bill amends many social affairs and employment laws, mainly to align benefit rules (dropping age-based exemptions, harmonising student and cost-sharing rules, electronic-only communication for cao and pension filings) and to tighten unemployment benefit, WIA, and dismissal rules. It also updates dismissal law, premium discount conditions and some enforcement and wage-continuation provisions, with a mostly technical delegation to ministerial and general administrative orders.
33988.j: The memorandum justifies delegations mainly as needed for technical complexity of daily-wage rules, suitable-work definitions and electronic communication, and to prevent circumvention of collective dismissal rules.
q: Because of the complexity of the daily-wage rules, a delegation provision was included in the fourth paragraph of article 3:13, as in the ZW, WW and Wet WIA, so that the substantive detail can be set in the Dagloonbesluit.
Vanwege de complexiteit van de dagloonregels is ervoor gekozen om, net als in de ZW, WW en Wet WIA, in het vierde lid van artikel 3:13, een delegatiebepaling op te nemen
d: electronic-only communication for cao and pension filings
detailed rules on suitable work (passende arbeid)
ARTIKEL XIV / Wet arbeid en zorg article 3:13 (vierde lid)
deviating rules on determining daily wage (dagloon)
ARTIKEL XXI / Wet melding collectief ontslag article 1 (tweede lid)
categories of workers treated as employees for collective dismissal notification
ARTIKEL XVII / Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen article 28 (eerste lid)
conditions delimiting categories of employers and employees for premium rates
ARTIKEL XXX / Wet structuur uitvoeringsorganisatie werk en inkomen article 32e (tweede lid)
organisation of electronic service delivery by UWV
p: ARTIKEL VI / Burgerlijk Wetboek article 7:671b (lid 10) and 7:686a
Courts may split dismissal petitions from related claims, and time limits are set for employer dismissal petitions after refused permission.
ARTIKEL XVII / Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen article 28 and article 47 and 48a
Premium discount application is conditioned on an employment document that the employer must keep, expanding administrative verification requirements.
ARTIKEL XX / Wet kinderopvang article 1.61a and 2.19a
The Minister may designate an institution to promote uniformity in childcare supervision, with financial support by ministerial decision.

parties: Asks why the omnibus bill's first, second and third amendment notes came so late with limited explanation, and asks about discretionary powers granted to the minister.
They see that the extensive first amendment note introduces new matters and ask why these could not have been included in the original bill from the start.
Zij zien dat de omvangrijke eerste nota van wijziging nieuwe zaken benoemt en vragen zich af waarom dit niet in eerste instantie bij het oorspronkelijke wetsvoorstel meegenomen kon worden.
Welcomes extending childcare allowance during unemployment to six months and the job-coaching support, and asks about budgetary effects of non-technical changes.
They are positive about the temporary extension of childcare allowance during unemployment from three to six months.
Zij zijn positief gestemd over de tijdelijke verlenging van de kinderopvangtoeslag bij werkloosheid van drie maanden naar zes maanden.

Objects that the fraud-law tightening makes IOAW/IOAZ benefits revisable without proportionality review, asks whether the Raad van State should be consulted again on the amendments, and questions the income effects of longer waiting periods.
Given the size of the amendment note, has the government considered asking the Council of State's advisory division for additional advice on its content?
Heeft de regering, gezien de omvang van de nota van wijziging, overwogen over de inhoud daarvan een aanvullend advies aan de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State te vragen?
Notes the bill mostly implements earlier parliamentary requests and asks when the ministerial regulation on volunteering by unemployed people will come and what it will contain.
For the CDA members one question remains about enabling volunteer work by unemployed people: when will the ministerial regulation come and what will its nature be?
Voor de leden van de CDA-fractie rest nog één vraag over het mogelijk maken van vrijwilligerswerk door werklozen: wanneer komt de ministeriële regeling en wat wordt de aard ervan?
Asks what the amendment to Participatiewet article 9 means for municipalities' search periods and whether volunteer-driven buurtbussen are affected by the volunteering rules.
Welcomes the rule that incidental income no longer permanently ends AOW partner allowance and asks about budgetary effects and possible perverse incentives.
These members wonder whether the inability to revive the partner allowance right for AOW recipients born before 1 January 1950 may produce undesirable effects.
Genoemde leden vragen zich af of het niet kunnen herleven van het recht op partnertoeslag voor AOW-gerechtigden die geboren zijn voor 1 januari 1950 mogelijk onwenselijke effecten oplevert.

34210-VII.s: The bill amends the 2015 departmental budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) and the budget of the Rijksdienst voor Identiteitsgegevens agency, adjusting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros. It sets entry into force as 1 June of the budget year, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: is amended, as appears from the corresponding budget schedule attached to this act
wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat

34300-VII.s: This bill fixes the 2016 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (BZK) and the 2016 budget statement for the Rijksdienst voor Identiteitsgegevens agency, in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes policy priorities and oversight matters but the bill itself contains no delegation or power-shifting provisions.
q: Article 1 The departmental budget statement for the year 2016 attached to this law is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2016 wordt vastgesteld.

34475-III.s: This bill sets the final (slotwet) adjustments to the 2015 budget statements for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King, the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services, and the agency Dienst Publiek en Communicatie. It makes the amended budget amounts legally binding and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December 2015.
q: We ... have deemed fit and resolved ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA) for the year 2015 is amended
Wij ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken (IIIA) voor het jaar 2015 wordt gewijzigd

34550-IX.s: This bill sets the 2017 departmental budget for the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt budget (IXA), fixing expenditure and revenue amounts in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes the budget policy articles, performance indicators and guarantee and oversight arrangements, without creating new executive powers.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2017 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2017 wordt vastgesteld.

34699.s: The bill removes the statutory duty of employers to pay the transitievergoeding (transition payment) on dismissal for long-term incapacity or business-economic reasons where a collective agreement provides an equivalent benefit, and allows collective agreements to exempt employers from that payment. It creates a UWV-administered compensation scheme (article 673e BW) reimbursing employers for transition payments in cases of long-term sickness-related termination, with recovery of overpayments and appeal routes.
34699.j: The memorandum justifies the collective-agreement route as a way to reduce the burden on employers and avoid negative workload effects on UWV, subject to equal treatment.
q: In the government's view, the aforementioned problems (both the excessive burden on employers and the obligation to pay a transition payment on business closure) can be addressed by providing, in collective labour agreements under article 7:673b BW, benefits that replace the transition payment legally owed by an employer.

Naar het oordeel van de regering kan aan de hiervoor genoemde problematiek (zowel de te zware belasting voor werkgevers, als het verschuldigd zijn van een transitievergoeding bij bedrijfsbeëindiging) tegemoet worden gekomen door in collectieve arbeidsovereenkomsten als bedoeld in artikel 7:673b BW, voorzieningen te treffen die in de plaats komen van de door een werkgever wettelijk verschuldigde transitievergoeding.
d: collective agreement or regulation by competent administrative body exempting transition payment
rules on application and payment of UWV compensation
p: Workers lose the statutory transition payment in certain cases, with collective agreements allowed to replace it, though equal treatment and court review remain available.

parties: Asks how cumulative employer burdens are reduced without undermining worker rights and whether the 1 January 2019 implementation date is feasible for UWV.
They attach importance to speed in legislating the full package of measures to remove the sharp edges of the transition allowance for entrepreneurs.
Zij hechten aan snelheid in de totstandkoming van wetgeving op het totale pakket aan maatregelen om de transitievergoeding voor ondernemers van haar scherpe randen te ontdoen.
Asks why the bill has retroactive effect and how robustly misuse is prevented and enforced.
The PVV members ask why the government chose to introduce this bill with retroactive effect.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen waarom ervoor kiest dit wetsvoorstel met terugwerkende kracht in te voeren.
Supports easing employer burdens but insists long-term incapacitated workers keep entitlement to the allowance and questions UWV feasibility and costs.
At the same time they consider it important that long-term incapacitated employees are entitled to a transition allowance.
Tegelijkertijd vinden zij het belangrijk dat langdurig arbeidsongeschikten recht hebben op een transitievergoeding.
Asks about budgetary effects, UWV's definitive view on feasibility, the lack of an evaluation provision, and possible abuse of the scheme.
The D66 members ask whether UWV can already give a definitive judgment on the feasibility of the compensation scheme.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen of het UWV al een definitief oordeel kan vellen over de uitvoerbaarheid van de compensatieregeling.

Insists workers' rights must not be impaired; worries that under the collective-agreement route workers may receive lower compensation without guaranteed access to alternative arrangements, and that non-bound workers may be left out.
The GroenLinks members are not reassured that this part of the bill does not impair workers' rights.
De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks zijn er niet gerust op dat dit deel van het wetsvoorstel de rechten van werknemers niet aantast.
Asks for the financial consequences of coalition agreement measures and how this bill relates to them.
What are the (financial) consequences of this intention and how and when does the government intend to incorporate it into the present bill?
Wat zijn de (financiële) consequenties van dit voornemen en op welke wijze en termijn is de regering voornemens deze bij het voorliggende wetsvoorstel te betrekken?
Asks whether the cumulation of obligations was intended and whether to await the SER study on sick-pay before legislating, and how a premium increase fits with lowering labour costs.
Shares the bill's intent but questions legal certainty and equality in the alternative collective-agreement compensation, lack of a lower bound, UWV workload and the Council of State's criticism.
The 'tailoring' of the old dismissal law has been 'sacrificed' to it.
Het «maatwerk» van het oude ontslagrecht is daaraan «opgeofferd».
Questions why the earlier separate treatment of illness and other grounds was abandoned, what legal change justifies it, and why no statutory safeguards exist where no collective agreement applies.
Why would it not legally be more obvious to weigh the concrete grounds, as was previously the case?
Waarom ligt het juridisch gezien niet veeleer voor de hand om de concrete gronden te wegen, zoals voorheen ook het geval was?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised against sending the bill on compensating employers for transitievergoeding owed to long-term incapacitated employees to parliament until its remarks were addressed, mainly because the scheme does not remove the root cause of cumulated employer obligations and its implementation burden on UWV is high. It also raised concerns about the cao-based replacement scheme for dismissals for business-economic reasons. The minister's nader rapport rejected the request to reconsider the compensation scheme but accepted the drafting points on the cao replacement provision and the cost indication.
concerns: The compensation scheme does not address the root cause of cumulated financial obligations for employers during long-term illness; alternatives such as abolishing the transitievergoeding for this group or adjusting wage continuation should be considered.

UWV implementation costs are expected to be high and the cost estimate was not sufficiently substantiated before the decision was taken; the government added an indicative structural cost figure but did not reconsider the scheme.

Excluding long-term incapacitated employees from the transitievergoeding would raise equal treatment and disability discrimination issues, so the government kept the entitlement and rejected the Council's alternative.

The vague criteria for a cao replacement provision (vervangende voorziening) may cause legal uncertainty and litigation; the bill was amended so the cao or regulation must expressly state the provision replaces the transitievergoeding.

Non-bound employees could claim the transitievergoeding despite a cao replacement provision; the government did not adopt a binding requirement but relied on incorporation clauses, and the draft provision was adjusted accordingly.

34730-IX.s: This bill amends the 2017 budget statements of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA) by adjusting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros. It is a first supplementary budget effective from 1 June 2017, with the explanatory memorandum covering budget changes for financial markets, including a deposit guarantee scheme for the BES islands.
34730-IX.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by explaining the costs of the BES deposit guarantee scheme, PSD II supervision and other items, but does not justify any delegation or new powers.
q: A deposit guarantee scheme (DGS) is being set up for the BES. An amvb to that effect is expected to be submitted to the Council of State for advice before summer 2017.
Voor de BES wordt een depositogarantiestelsel (DGS) opgezet. Een amvb met die strekking zal naar verwachting voor de zomer van 2017 voor advies worden voorgelegd aan de Raad van State.

34775-X.s: This bill fixes the 2018 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence and the 2018 budget statements of the agencies DTO and Paresto, in thousands of euros, with effect from 1 January 2018. The explanatory memorandum is largely a policy and budget narrative on defence capabilities, intelligence funding and agency finances rather than a delegation or power-shifting measure.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2018 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2018 wordt vastgesteld.

34789.s: The bill implements the EU Benchmarks Regulation (2016/1011) in Dutch law by amending the Wft to allow temporary bans on benchmark administrators' staff, making violations of two articles criminally punishable under the WED, and setting AFM fees for benchmark authorisation, registration and recognition applications. It sets the entry-into-force date by royal decree and leaves implementation details to a further implementing decree.
34789.j: The memorandum justifies the criminal enforcement route by saying it makes separate administrative powers for asset freezing and profit recovery unnecessary, as they already exist in criminal law.
q: By making criminal enforcement possible, it is in any case not necessary to grant some of the powers required by the benchmarks regulation to the administrative supervisor.

Door het mogelijk maken van strafrechtelijke handhaving is het overigens niet nodig enkele door de verordening financiële benchmarks vereiste bevoegdheden aan de bestuursrechtelijke toezichthouder toe te kennen.
d: entry-into-force date of the act, which may differ per article
p: Violations are made criminally enforceable under the WED, and the memorandum explains that the public prosecutor, not the administrative supervisor, will use asset-freezing and profit-recovery powers, with prosecution subject to the criminal process.
Extends the supervisor's existing power to temporarily ban individuals from holding functions to benchmark administrators, a narrow and specified expansion.

parties: Asks how the AFM's new power to bar individuals from functions at benchmark administrators will work and whether the rules on non-registered benchmarks amount to a ban, raising questions about regulatory discretion and oversight.
Has no further questions at this stage.
They have no further questions at this stage.
Zij hebben vooralsnog geen verdere vragen.

Argues that supervision of benchmark administrators was too weak, asks for stronger supervision and enforcement, including against collusion, and suggests the AFM should actively investigate and publish findings.
The SP members ask how it was possible that there was so little supervision of benchmark administrators.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen hoe het mogelijk is, dat er voor beheerders van benchmarks zo weinig toezicht is geweest.

34798.s: The bill approves the intended denunciation of the 1978 Hague Convention on the law applicable to matrimonial property regimes for the European part of the Netherlands, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It takes effect on the first day of the third calendar month after publication in the Staatsblad.
34798.j: The memorandum justifies denunciation by noting that EU Regulation 2016/1103 now places treaty-making competence on this subject with the European Union.
q: With the adoption of the regulation, competence to conclude treaties with third states in private international law on matrimonial property has however passed to the European Union.

Met de totstandkoming van de verordening is de bevoegdheid tot het aangaan van verdragen met derde staten op het terrein van internationale privaatrecht betreffende het huwelijksvermogensrecht evenwel bij de Europese Unie komen te berusten.

parties: Asks why other states never joined the Convention, how France and Luxembourg responded, and whether they will also withdraw and when.
Has there been contact with France and Luxembourg about the Dutch intention to withdraw?
Is er contact geweest met Frankrijk en Luxemburg over het Nederlandse voornemen tot opzegging?
Asks why Austria and Portugal never ratified, what consequences the three-year overlap with the Regulation may have, and how the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom are involved.
Since the European part of the Netherlands is bound under international law to apply the Convention's provisions, these members ask what consequences this may have during these three years.

Aangezien het Europese deel van Nederland volkenrechtelijk gehouden is aan de toepassing van de bepalingen uit het verdrag, vragen de genoemde leden wat voor een gevolgen dit kan hebben gedurende deze drie jaren.
Asks whether withdrawal automatically applies to the public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, and to what extent transitional law for existing marriages is needed.
These members ask whether this automatically means the Convention is also withdrawn for the public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba.
Deze leden vragen of dit automatisch betekent dat het Verdrag ook ingetrokken wordt inzake de openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba.

34879.s: The bill amends the Wet uitkeringen burger-oorlogsslachtoffers 1940–1945 and the Wet uitkeringen vervolgingsslachtoffers 1940–1945 so that the return on savings and investments used for benefit calculations follows the new box 3 rendement classes from 1 January 2017. It also gives the Minister power to set the exempt amount in the vervolgingsslachtoffers act, with retroactive effect to 1 January 2017.
34879.j: The memorandum justifies the change as a consequence of the 1 January 2017 amendment to box 3 of the Wet IB 2001 and does not explain the ministerial delegation.
q: From the amount so calculated, an amount is exempted, the height of which is determined by Our Minister.
Van het aldus berekende bedrag wordt een bedrag vrijgelaten, waarvan de hoogte door Onze Minister wordt bepaald.
d: II (art. 19, vijfde lid, Wet uitkeringen vervolgingsslachtoffers)
amount of income exempted from calculated return on assets

parties: Welcomes the simple amendment and asks one clarifying question; raises no check-related concern.
These members have only one clarifying question.
Deze leden hebben slechts één verhelderende vraag.

Is astonished that another deviation from box 3 rules is needed, asks whether side effects of tax changes were foreseen, and asks the government to monitor such downstream effects in future legislation.
These members attach importance to monitoring this knock-on effect in future legislative changes.
Deze leden hechten eraan dat bij toekomstige wetswijzigingen deze doorwerking wel in de gaten wordt gehouden.
Asks how the planned real-return wealth tax may affect this law and how future amendments can avoid retroactive effect.
The D66 members ask how future amendments can be more closely aligned with fiscal changes so that such a change does not need to take effect retroactively.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen hoe er in het vervolg nauwer aangesloten kan worden op de fiscale wijzigingen, zodat een dergelijke wijziging niet met terugwerkende kracht in werking hoeft te treden.

34888.s: This bill amends the 2018 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) through an incidental supplementary budget, adding about 78 million euros in expenditure and receipts across several policy articles. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from 19 February 2018, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport for 2018
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

34897.s: The bill amends the 2018 departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (XII) through an incidental supplementary budget for reconstruction of Saba and Sint Eustatius, with an effective date of 1 March 2018. It makes no delegation of rule-making power and no changes to oversight or judicial review.
q: We have found and decided, with the joint consent of the States General ... The departmental budget statement for 2018 is amended, as shown in the budget statement attached to this law.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2018 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34987.s: This technical bill renames references to the former Ministry of Economic Affairs (and its Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit and Economische Zaken en Klimaat successors) across dozens of Dutch statutes, following the departmental reorganisation, and fixes several drafting errors. It also merges agricultural and economic subsidy grounds into an amended Kaderwet EZ-subsidies and makes a few minor ministerial-regulation wording changes.
34987.j: The memorandum justifies the subsidy changes as a way to avoid two new framework laws by amending the existing Kaderwet EZ-subsidies, which would provide a basis for regulations on subsidies.
q: A joint framework law covering both ministries provides a basis for all subsidies for which no specific legal basis exists in specific laws.
Een gezamenlijke kaderwet op het terrein van beide ministeries biedt een grondslag voor alle subsidies waarvoor geen specifieke grondslag in specifieke wetten bestaat.
d: rules under the animal welfare act (now set by ministerial regulation)
service-provider rules, now assigned to the Minister of Interior

parties: Asks why the subsidy activity list in the Kaderwet EZ-subsidies is non-exhaustive and why the subsidy powers are not linked to the sector's long-term goal, raising concerns about the breadth of ministerial discretion.
Can the government explain the reason behind this list of activities under paragraph 1, since paragraph 2 seems to serve the same function?
Kan de regering toelichten wat de reden is achter deze opsomming van activiteiten onder lid 1, aangezien lid 2 dezelfde functie lijkt te dienen?

Asks why a Gas Act amendment is included in this bill rather than the energy transition bill, and what tariff effects and unexpected cost surprises for consumers could follow from the proposed discounting and experiment costs.
Despite the planned consultation between grid operators and the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM), they ask whether unexpected large surprises could still arise regarding costs and tariffs.

Deze leden vragen of dit nader kan worden toegelicht. Ondanks het voorgenomen overleg tussen netbeheerders en de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) vragen zij of er toch niet onverwachts grote verrassingen kunnen optreden ten aanzien van de kosten en de tarieven.
Asks how many full-time staff the ministry has for animal welfare, agriculture, nature, food and fisheries files compared with previous ministries, a question about capacity rather than checks.
How many full-time equivalents are available within the current Ministry of LNV for these files?
Hoeveel fte is er binnen het huidige Ministerie van LNV beschikbaar voor deze dossiers?

35000-XII.s: This bill formally establishes the 2019 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (XII) and the agency budget statements, in thousands of euros, with a 1 January 2019 effective date. It shifts no executive powers; it is purely a budgetary appropriation act.
q: Article 1: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management for the year 2019 attached to this act is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat voor het jaar 2019 wordt vastgesteld.

35200-VII.s: This is a supplementary budget bill (Slotwet) that amends the 2018 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budget statements of its executive agencies. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendments retroactive to 31 December of the budget year, with no explanatory memorandum provided.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2018 is amended, as shown in the statement annexed to this law.

De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2018 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35450-IX.s: This bill amends the 2020 departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt budget (IXA), adjusting appropriations and receipts per article in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as 1 May 2020, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
35450-IX.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by economic uncertainty and the government's emergency measures, with the cabinet promising to inform parliament after the June forecast.
q: After the June forecast is calculated, the cabinet will inform parliament with an up-to-date picture of tax revenue, the EMU balance and the EMU debt.
Na doorrekening van de juniraming zal het kabinet het parlement informeren met een actueel beeld van belastinginkomsten, EMU-saldo en EMU-schuld.

35470-IV.s: This is a supplementary budget bill (slotwet) that amends the 2019 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds (H), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts to reflect the realised figures. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The lower realisation of commitments and expenditure mainly results from lower spending at the Colleges financieel toezicht (Cft) of € 0.7 million.
De lagere realisatie op de verplichtingen en uitgaven komt voornamelijk voort uit lagere uitgaven bij de Colleges financieel toezicht (Cft) van € 0,7 mln.

35470-VI.s: This is a Dutch Slotwet (closing budget law) for 2019 that amends the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security and the budget statement for its executive agencies, setting realised figures for police, justice, detention, migration and other policy articles. It does not delegate rule-making power, shift power between institutions, or change oversight or judicial review.

35599.s: The bill amends the Wet op het financieel toezicht to ban insurers based outside the EU from providing insurance and reinsurance services into the Netherlands, with exemptions set by ministerial regulation. A transitional regime lets existing cross-border insurers keep operating for a limited period, with the Nederlandsche Bank able to extend wind-down deadlines by up to twelve months.
35599.j: The memorandum justifies the ban by arguing that Dutch supervisors cannot effectively control non-EU insurers, and that the central bank's extension power protects Dutch policyholders during wind-down.
q: Dutch measures will not be effective in this context.
Nederlandse maatregelen zullen in deze context niet effectief zijn.
d: full or partial exemption from articles 2:26d and 2:26f, with conditions
full or partial exemption from articles 2:40, 2:45 and 2:46, with conditions
rules on designating member states whose supervision is deemed adequate
withdrawal of designation of member states by the Minister
Nederlandsche Bank may extend wind-down deadlines by up to 12 months
p: The minister may grant exemptions from core licensing and supervision obligations by regulation, subject to conditions the minister sets.

The central bank may extend transitional wind-down periods by up to twelve months where it deems this reasonably necessary, a discretionary power without a clear judicial or parliamentary check stated in the bill.

The bill bans cross-border services from non-EU insurers, a substantive restriction on market access, with a transitional regime of fixed periods and designation of member states by ministerial order.

parties: Asks how the bill relates to Brexit negotiations and how many insurers are affected, and whether the bill should have waited until after 1 January 2021.
Would it not have been more logical to submit this bill after 1 January 2021, given the negotiations?
Had het niet voor de hand gelegen dit wetsvoorstel ná 1 januari 2021 in te dienen, met het oog op de onderhandelingen?
Asks why DNB and AFM have limited powers to protect Dutch policyholders and why cooperation agreements with foreign supervisors are restricted, and requests the impact analysis outcomes.
The PVV members want to know whether this means Dutch policyholders are not protected at all or only somewhat protected.</evidence_en>
De leden van de PVV-fractie willen weten of dit betekent dat de Nederlandse polishouders helemaal niet beschermd zijn of enigszins beschermd zijn
Asks whether withdrawing insurers must notify DNB or AFM, who is responsible for market diversity, and whether the herverzekering exception adds unnecessary complexity.
In that context, the CDA members ask whether the government or the supervisor is responsible for the diversity of the insurance market.</evidence_en>
In dat kader vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie wie, de regering of de toezichthouder, verantwoordelijk is voor de diversiteit van de verzekeringsmarkt.
Stresses that consumers must not become victims and asks what information and help policyholders will receive when policies must be transferred, and how long-running contracts are handled.
These members see it as an important starting point of this amendment that consumers must not become the victims of it.</evidence_en>
Deze leden zien als belangrijk uitgangspunt bij deze wijziging dat consumenten niet de dupe mogen worden hiervan
Welcomes the increased consumer protection the bill aims for and has no additional questions.
They are positive about the increase in consumer protection this bill aims for and have no additional questions.</evidence_en>
Zij zijn positief over de toename in bescherming van consumenten die dit wetsvoorstel beoogt en hebben geen aanvullende vragen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division raised no remarks on the bill amending the Wet op het financieel toezicht to ban services by third-country insurers, and advised submitting it to parliament. The minister's nader rapport reports that transitional provisions in article II were supplemented and clarified, including an extended six-month wind-down period and rules for reinsurers and for insurers that apply for a licence.

35650-IV.s: The bill amends the 2020 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds (H) through a second supplementary budget, shifting funds among rule of law, debt rescheduling, and reconstruction of the Caribbean Netherlands. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective retroactively from 1 December 2020.
35650-IV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by the need to cover rising costs such as liquidity support to Sint Maarten and reallocations for legal capacity, without delegating new powers.
q: Amendment of the 2020 budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) (Second supplementary budget)
Wijziging begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) voor het jaar 2020 (Tweede suppletoire begroting)

35650-VI.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2020 departmental budget statement and the agency budget statements of the Ministry of Justice and Security, adding funds for COVID-related effects, personal protective equipment and agency deficits. It shifts appropriations and receipts across policy articles without creating new executive delegations or changes to oversight.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security and of the agency budget statements of this ministry, all for the year 2020
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, van de begrotingsstaat inzake de agentschappen van dit ministerie, alle voor het jaar 2020

35689.s: The bill amends the Dutch Explosives Precursors Act and the Economic Offences Act to implement EU Regulation 2019/1148 on explosives precursors, updating ministry names, verification and permit rules, and sanctions. It delegates detailed rules on how market operators offer restricted precursors and verification duties to ministerial regulation, and adds a background-check (VOG) requirement for permits.
35689.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as necessary to implement the EU regulation, which requires national authorities to act and limits room for national choices.
q: Article 6(5) of the regulation prevents a decision to suspend or withdraw a permit from being published where this would jeopardise an ongoing investigation.

Artikel 6, vijfde lid, van de verordening staat eraan in de weg dat een beschikking tot schorsing of intrekking van een vergunning bekend wordt gemaakt als daardoor een lopend onderzoek in gevaar wordt gebracht.
d: I, B / I, I (artikel 8, tweede lid, Wpe)
rules on how market operators offer precursors and online marketplace duties
designating additional substances and setting concentration thresholds
rules on reporting suspicious transactions, disappearances and thefts
p: The minister may refuse a permit if, in the minister's view, the intended use is not proportionate to its purpose, widening discretion over permit decisions.

Suspension or withdrawal of a permit takes effect on the day it is made, departing from the normal publication rule of the General Administrative Law Act, with publication only once investigations no longer risk being jeopardised.

parties: Accepts the direct effect of the EU regulation and the limited change to current practice, raising no further questions.
Given the direct effect of the regulation and the limited change in current practice, they have no further questions.
Zij hebben gezien de directe doorwerking van de verordening en de beperkte wijziging in de huidige praktijk geen verdere vragen.
Asks why professional users are not licensed, how business need is demonstrated, and what safeguards apply to permit checks at online sales and delivery by third parties.
The aforementioned members ask what safeguards the law contains regarding the checks market participants must carry out when offering explosive precursors on online marketplaces.

Voornoemde leden vragen welke waarborgen er zijn in de wet ten aanzien van de controles die marktdeelnemers dienen uit te voeren, wanneer zij precursoren voor explosieven aanbieden op online marktplaatsen.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering advised on a bill implementing EU Regulation 2019/1148 on explosives precursors by amending the Wet precursoren voor explosieven and the Wet op de economische delicten, raising no substantive remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport thanks the Afdeling and reports only minor editorial and technical improvements to the bill and explanatory memorandum.

35779.s: The bill introduces a supplementary withholding tax on dividends paid to affiliated recipients in low-tax jurisdictions and in abusive situations, by amending the Wet bronbelasting 2021 with new definitions, a dividend income base, rules on paid-in capital in share exchanges, mergers and demergers, and an anti-abuse presumption. It applies from 1 January 2024 and, for jurisdictions listed in the ministerial regulation, follows a three-year delay after listing.
35779.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as part of the continued effort to combat tax avoidance, and the inspector's discretion is said to be bound by general principles of good administration.
d: determination of paid-in capital by tax inspector
p: A share exchange, demerger or merger is presumed to be aimed at avoiding tax unless the taxpayer shows business reasons, shifting the burden of proof to taxpayers.
Where a demerger is predominantly aimed at avoiding tax by a Dutch demerging entity, the exemption falls away and the receipt is treated as a profit distribution.

parties: Asks whether the 3-year transition period is realistic, whether the dual-withholding relief prevents double taxation, and how the bill interacts with the Snels initiative bill and the administrative costs.
The VVD members ask whether this is a sufficient safeguard to prevent double taxation.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of dit een voldoende waarborg is om dubbele heffing te voorkomen.
Supports tackling dividend-based tax avoidance but asks about other measures considered, the evaluation clause, the effect on SMEs and whether the law is consistent with EU free movement of capital.
The D66 members ask why no evaluation provision has been included in the law.
De leden van de fractie van D66 vragen waarom er geen evaluatiebepaling is opgenomen in de wet.
Requests worked numerical examples for several scenarios and asks whether the Tax Authority can enforce the bill with 8 FTE, given enforcement difficulties.
The PVV members note that the Tax Authority raises considerable reservations about the enforceability of the law.
De leden van de PVV-fractie constateren dat de Belastingdienst bij de handhaafbaarheid van de wet aanzienlijke kanttekeningen plaatst.

Supports measures against abuse but questions the choice of legal vehicle, the complexity added to the Dividend Tax Act, the sharp rise in enforcement costs, and the 25% charge in hybrid situations without low-tax or abuse elements.
They consider it undesirable that in some cases a 25 percent levy can arise without low taxation or abuse being present.
Zij achten het onwenselijk dat in gevallen een heffing van 25 procent kan ontstaan zonder dat sprake is van te lage belasting of misbruik.
Welcomes the approach but asks why the statutory rather than effective tax rate is used, what abuse means versus unintended use, and why the measure only starts in 2024.
The SP members regret that the withholding tax is only introduced from 2024.
De leden van de SP-fractie betreuren het dat de bronbelasting pas per 2024 wordt ingevoerd.

Considers taxing dividends to tax havens desirable, questions the 2024 start date and the choice of Wet bronbelasting over the Dividend Tax Act, and asks about conflicting provisions and the 5%/qualifying-interest threshold.
Is the government willing to apply the conditional withholding tax from 1 January 2022?
Is de regering bereid om vanaf 1 januari 2022 de conditionele bronbelasting toe te passen?

Asks whether the anti-abuse provision applies, whether substance requirements can be bought from trust offices, the burden of proof, and why certain exemptions for non-holding cooperatives and capital repayments were left out.
Is it correct that a large part of the substance requirements on this list can be purchased by the foreign intermediary from external parties such as a trust office?
Klopt het dat een (groot deel van) van de substance-eisen op dit lijstje door de buitenlandse tussenschakel kan worden ingekocht bij externe partijen, zoals een trustkantoor?
Supports a firm approach to tax avoidance but asks why the measure starts only in 2024, how the anti-abuse rule works in practice, and how businesses might restructure, calling for a broader package.
They ask the government to explain in more detail the decision not to tax these dividend flows already from 2021 despite integration into the Wet bronbelasting 2021.
Zij vragen de regering uitgebreider in te gaan op het besluit om ondanks het integreren in de Wet bronbelasting 2021 de genoemde dividendstromen niet ook al vanaf 2021 te belasten.
Asks about expected effects on the investment climate, job losses, and historical dividend flows in the two targeted situations.
The SGP members ask the government about the expected effects on the investment climate.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen de regering naar de verwachte gevolgen op het vestigingsklimaat.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division reviewed a Dutch bill introducing a 25% conditional withholding tax on dividends paid to low-tax jurisdictions and in abuse situations, criticising the lack of transparency in the internet consultation and the omission of a consultation remark on dividends falling below 25% outside low-tax jurisdictions. The Secretary of State's reply largely accepted the consultation criticism, added explanation on the EU-law aspects, and adopted the drafting corrections, while rejecting the proposed wording change to article 1.2 with a reasoned justification.
concerns: The Council criticised that the internet consultation lacked a general part of the explanatory memorandum, answers to the IAK questions and effect assessments, reducing transparency; the government defended the choice on timing grounds and says transparency was sufficiently safeguarded.

The Council noted that the explanatory memorandum failed to address a consultation remark that the bill could bring dividends paid by Dutch withholding agents below 25% outside low-tax jurisdictions or base erosion, and advised addressing it and adapting the bill if needed; the government supplemented the memorandum.

Redactional comments on the wording of article 1.2, the title of article 3.4c, the phrasing on shares, dates in an example, and a more detailed EU-law section; the government adopted most but rejected the article 1.2 wording change with reasons.

The Council advised a more substantive and detailed explanation of the bill's relationship to EU law, in particular free movement rules and secondary EU legislation; the government added some explanation but pointed to existing coverage in the Wet bronbelasting 2021.

35797.s: This bill amends the 2021 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science through an eighth supplementary budget, mainly for debt forgiveness for childcare benefit victims and a study-finance estimate. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect from 8 April 2021, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Article 1 The budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35830-IV.s: This bill is a slotwet that adopts the final 2020 budget amendments (wijziging) for the Koninkrijksrelaties budget (IV) and the BES-fonds (H), stating the final budgeted, supplementary and realised amounts in thousands of euros. It sets the entry into force of the law and gives no new delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decreed ... The budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) for the year 2020 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) voor het jaar 2020 wordt gewijzigd

35830-VI.s: This bill is a supplementary budget adoption (Slotwet) that amends the 2020 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security and the budget statement for its agencies, setting realised figures against the estimates. It changes appropriations and actual spending figures in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 31 December 2020.
q: We, Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security (VI) for the year 2020 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid (VI) voor het jaar 2020 wordt gewijzigd

35869.s: The bill amends Book 4 of the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure to add a three-year experimental (pilot) set of innovations: a preliminary-ruling procedure before the Supreme Court, rules for examining devices and later-arriving data after seizure, audiovisual recording as lawful evidence and as substitute for a full record, expanded powers for the hulpofficier van justitie, and mediation after trial has begun. It sunsets after three years unless extended by a further bill, and the ministers must report on effectiveness within two years of entry into force.
35869.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as temporary experiments to test efficiency and effectiveness in practice, with procedural safeguards and a three-year horizon for evaluation.
q: This horizon provision expresses the temporary and experimental character of the regulation.
Met deze horizonbepaling wordt het tijdelijke en experimentele karakter van de regelgeving tot uitdrukking gebracht.
d: rules on content of abbreviated official record of recordings
rules on content of abbreviated trial record
limit application of title provisions to specific districts
p: Officer of justice may order police to examine seized devices and later-arriving data for three days, extendable to three months with investigating judge approval, and to break biometric protection against the user's will.

Certain investigative powers currently reserved to the public prosecutor, such as historical and future data requests and number identification orders, may be exercised by the hulpofficier van justitie during the pilot.
Audiovisual recordings may replace full official records and be admitted as lawful evidence, with police able to defer drafting full reports.
Courts may refer legal questions to the Supreme Court in a preliminary procedure with party consultation, strengthening judicial clarification of law."}],
Courts gain options to terminate or suspend cases for mediation begun after trial starts.

parties: Asks about the enforceability of mediation agreements, the role of victims in the prejudicial procedure, and the three-month limit on network search after seizure.
Can the government explain how compliance with mediation agreements works in practice and what steps are taken when agreements are not or insufficiently complied with?

Kan de regering in haar antwoord schetsen hoe in de praktijk naleving van mediationafspraken plaatsvindt en welke stappen op welk moment worden gezet indien afspraken niet of onvoldoende worden nageleefd?
Calls for parliamentary involvement in extensions of rights-infringing measures and questions the lack of judicial authorisation for network search after seizure.

Given the many recent discussions on the importance of parliamentary involvement in extending measures that infringe fundamental rights, these members expect that such a choice will no longer be made in future.

Gezien de vele recente discussies over het belang van parlementaire betrokkenheid bij de verlenging van maatregelen die ingrijpen op de grondrechten spreken deze leden de verwachting uit dat die keuze in het vervolg niet meer zal worden gemaakt.
Asks how the equality of arms principle is safeguarded for the injured party in the prejudicial procedure.
These members ask the government to explain how it weighs the equality of arms principle in this regard?
Deze leden vragen de regering uit te leggen hoe zij hierin het «equality of arms» principe weegt?
Asks about the proportionality of forced unlocking of devices by biometrics and the timing and limits of the seizure-related powers.
How is it concretely guaranteed that forced unlocking of an automated device is at all times proportionate?
Hoe wordt concreet gewaarborgd dat het onder dwang ontgrendelen van een geautomatiseerd werk te allen tijde proportioneel is?
Supports the prejudicial procedure but questions the threshold of special weight, possible prolongation of pre-trial detention, and why a separate statutory track was not chosen.
These members would find it undesirable if raising a prejudicial question led to unnecessary extension of pre-trial detention.
Deze leden zouden het niet wenselijk vinden wanneer het stellen van prejudiciële procedure leidt tot onnodige verlenging van de voorlopige hechtenis.
Questions compatibility of the compelled biometric unlocking power with the nemo tenetur principle and ECtHR case law, and asks for controls on the power.
Which control mechanisms does the government establish for this? How is oversight of this power organised?
Welke controlemechanismen stelt de regering hiervoor in? Hoe wordt het toezicht op deze bevoegdheid vormgegeven?
Asks for the delegated AMvB rules on the pilots to be available before debate and raises concerns about legal uncertainty and funding for pilots.
Can the government indicate whether these AMvBs have already been drafted and whether the House can take note of them before debating the bill?
Kan de regering aangeven of deze AMvB’s al opgesteld zijn en of de Kamer kennis kan nemen van deze AMvB’s alvorens over het wetsvoorstel te debatteren.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the Innovation Act on criminal procedure be split: the prejudicial questions procedure and the seizure-related powers over computers are mature enough to enact now, while the other three elements are genuine experiments needing clearer design, limits on the extension-by-decree clause, and stronger safeguards.
