The Ministers rejected the split and most advice, but accepted several changes including parliamentary involvement for extensions, a stricter lawful-use threshold for the prejudicial procedure's scope, and clarifications on pilots.
concerns: The Afdeling objected to extension by general administrative order without parliamentary involvement; the government moved extension to formal law but kept a three-year term.
The Afdeling advised splitting off the prejudicial procedure and seizure powers as mature, non-experimental regulations; the government declined.
The Afdeling advised limiting the post-three-day powers to serious offences matching comparable covert powers; the government did not follow this.
The Afdeling asked for explanation of why biometric unlocking does not breach the nemo tenetur principle; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented accordingly.
The Afdeling asked for clarification of the high-weight threshold and the scope of 'strafrechtelijke procedures' for prejudicial questions; the memorandum was expanded.
The Afdeling required safeguards for defence access to audiovisual recordings and a clear visa on the hulpofficier van justitie's position; partly addressed through pilot design.
Redactional remarks were adopted in the bill and memorandum.

35887.s: The bill amends the temporary COVID-19 election law to scale back pandemic measures for the 2021 redistricting elections, mainly by creating a municipal polling board for early voting that counts early votes and by lowering the number of deputy board members. It also lets the Minister exempt health measures at polling stations by ministerial regulation, removes proxy and postal-vote rules, and allows partial lapse of the law before its general expiry.
35887.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial power to switch off health rules by the need to respond flexibly to changing corona conditions, and partial lapse so measures can be proportionate.
q: By being able to scale back the health measures by ministerial regulation, one can respond flexibly to developments in the spread of the coronavirus.
Door de gezondheidsmaatregelen bij ministeriële regeling te kunnen afschalen, kan flexibel worden ingespeeld op de ontwikkelingen met betrekking tot de verspreiding van het coronavirus
d: fixing the number of deputy members of the main polling board
composition and working method of the municipal early-voting polling board
switching off health check, hygiene and personal protection rules at polling stations
opening limited-access polling stations when corona circumstances require it
further rules on counting at polling boards and handling of unused ballots
partial lapse of individual provisions of the temporary law
p: The Minister may by ministerial regulation disapply statutory health and hygiene rules for polling stations without parliamentary approval, with the temporary law as overall sunset limit.
Allows individual provisions of the temporary law to lapse earlier, a step that cannot easily be reversed, without a new bill.  ;

parties: Asks how the bill relates to the recent rise in infections and whether it was already in preparation.
Was this bill already in preparation at that time?
Was dit wetsvoorstel toen al in voorbereiding?

Supports a legal basis for future covid measures and gradual scaling back, but questions the rationale for differing closing times and the number of polling stations, and asks about maximum proxy votes.
These members therefore consider it sensible to provide a legal basis to be able to take further measures for upcoming elections.
Deze leden achten het daarom verstandig om te voorzien in een grondslag om voor komende verkiezingen nog maatregelen te kunnen treffen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division raised no remarks on the bill amending the temporary COVID-19 elections act to phase out special COVID measures at elections, and advised submitting it to the House. The minister's reply notes the bill was amended on two points: mask-wearing voters are exempted even after the mandate lapses, and the municipal postal-vote board must re-establish the number of eligible voters on a count discrepancy.

35968.s: The bill replaces the Archiefwet 1995 with a new Archiefwet 2021, modernising rules for digital records management and shortening the transfer period of records to archival services from 20 to 10 years. It also restructures responsibilities, selection and destruction rules, access and openness restrictions, and extends archival oversight to transferred records while making the archivist position mandatory for provinces, municipalities and water boards.
35968.j: The memorandum justifies delegations by the need for detailed, technically evolving rules on digital records management and by the practical need for flexibility in selection and transfer procedures.
q: The intention to set rules in the new Archiefbesluit allowing responsible government bodies to deviate in certain cases from an adopted selection decision.
Het voornemen om in het nieuwe Archiefbesluit nadere regels te stellen die mogelijk maken dat verantwoordelijke overheidsorganen in bepaalde gevallen afwijken van een vastgesteld selectiebesluit.
d: measures for durable accessibility of records
content and procedure of selection decisions and deviations
Prime Minister may set rules deviating from destruction rules in extraordinary circumstances
procedure and conditions for early transfer
procedure for exemption from transfer obligation
minister transfers responsibility for records to bodies by decision
rules on access requests for restricted records
p: Minister may transfer records responsibility to municipal, provincial and regional bodies by decision, with the ministerial power to revoke retained.
Minister may revoke a responsibility transfer decision on listed grounds, including policy reconsideration after five years.
Archive officials may postpone transfer of records for renewable periods of up to ten years, with conditions attached.
Restriction periods on public access may be extended by decision for specific records with approval of the provincial executive or minister.
Central-government archive oversight is exercised by inspectors appointed by the minister, who reports annually to parliament.
Minister may issue binding instructions and coercive administrative orders to bodies not complying with the act, but not against core state bodies.
Prime Minister may set rules allowing departure from destruction rules in extraordinary circumstances, without statutory limits on scope.

parties: Worries that selection decisions can hardly be reconsidered if only legal interested parties may request it, and asks how the objection procedure stays accessible.

Does the government share the concern of these members that a selection decision will soon hardly be reconsiderable when only interested parties within the meaning of the General Administrative Law Act can request it?

Deelt de regering de zorg van deze leden dat een selectiebesluit straks bijna niet meer heroverwogen kan worden wanneer alleen belanghebbenden in de zin van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht (hierna: Awb) dit kunnen verzoeken?
Asks why independent supervision was not chosen, and how information chain quality is guaranteed without an independent supervisor.
Can the government explain why independent supervision was not chosen and how the quality of the information chain is guaranteed without an independent supervisor?
Kan de regering uiteenzetten waarom er niet is gekozen voor onafhankelijk toezicht en hoe de kwaliteit van de informatieketen zonder onafhankelijke toezichthouder wordt gewaarborgd?
Notes that dropping the public consultation for selection decisions removes citizens from view and questions whether openness is safeguarded when exemptions and many refusal grounds apply.
The members of the CDA faction note that the citizen thereby disappears from view.
De leden van de CDA-fractie constateren dat de burger hiermee uit beeld verdwijnt.
Argues the bill may produce less openness, since exemptions from transfer and fifteen refusal grounds could let more remain secret than under the 1995 Act.

How does the proposed amendment contribute to more openness if the possibility exists not to transfer documents, and exemption can be granted, and as many as twelve further grounds exist to refuse disclosure?
Hoe draagt de voorgestelde wijziging bij aan meer openbaarheid als én de mogelijkheid bestaat documenten niet over te brengen
Worried that the bill lacks guarantees that government action is recorded so the government can account for itself, and that more can remain secret than under the 1995 Act.
The members are mainly concerned that the bill lacks guarantees that government action is recorded, so that archives are formed with which the government can account for itself.
Het baart de leden vooral zorgen dat in het wetsvoorstel waarborgen ontbreken dat het handelen van de overheid wordt vastgelegd
Asks for a stronger, single supervisory authority and clarity on citizens' rights to learn what data about them is held.
Asks why the Minister of BZK does not co-sign the bill and about the need for an overarching framework law linking openness and archiving.
Against this background they ask why it is not obvious that the bill is co-signed by the Minister of BZK.</br>
Tegen deze achtergrond vragen zij waarom het niet voor de hand ligt dat het wetsvoorstel mede door de Minister van BZK is ondertekend
Asks whether the ministerial exemption and revocation powers are clearly divided between gedeputeerde staten and the Minister, and whether public archiving rules are accessible to citizens.
For the members, it is not yet clear from the statutory text and explanatory memorandum whether the Minister can also revoke an exemption granted by gedeputeerde staten, and vice versa.
Voor de leden is vanuit de wettekst en memorie van toelichting nog niet duidelijk of de Minister ook een ontheffing kan intrekken die door gedeputeerde staten worden verleend en andersom.
Asks whether the algemene rijksarchivaris should have binding or stronger guiding authority and whether the government accepts the advice for a broader overarching vision on information governance.

I miss proposals in the present documents to strengthen the role and position of the (general) state archivist.](Adviser quote) ...I miss proposals in the present documents to strengthen the role and position of the (general) state archivist.'
Ik mis voorstellen in de onderhavige documenten om de rol en positie van de (algemene) rijksarchivaris te verstevigen.

Worries the new law still allows more secrecy than before because it lacks safeguards on documenting government action, and asks the government to justify each of the new openness restriction grounds.
They fear that under the new Archiefwet in its current form, more can still effectively remain secret than under the Archiefwet 1995.
Zij vrezen dat er met de nieuwe Archiefwet in zijn huidige vorm nog altijd feitelijk meer geheim kan blijven dan onder de Archiefwet 1995.
Shares concern about insufficient safeguards and the expansion from three to fifteen openness restriction grounds, asking for per-ground justification.
Can the government further explain, per restriction ground, on what grounds the thirteen new restriction grounds are justified.
Kan de regering per beperkingsgrond nader toelichten op grond van welke overwegingen de dertien nieuwe beperkingsgronden ... gerechtvaardigd zijn.
Raises risk that the exemption from transfer lets authorities avoid transferring archives, and that archivists reporting only to their own board offers no external supervision.
There is no external supervision; at most external review is possible.
Van extern toezicht is geen sprake, er kan hoogstens extern worden getoetst.
Asks about the legal basis for retention criteria, the Aarhus Convention environmental restriction ground, and whether dropping the diploma requirement is adequately justified.
These members ask on what basis in the bill these criteria form the elaboration.
Deze leden vragen van welke grondslag in het wetsvoorstel deze criteria de uitwerking vormen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the draft Archiefwet 2021, which shortens the archiving period from twenty to ten years and expands supervision, raising concerns about government information management, the document definition, the relation to the Woo, the archivist's position and post-transfer openness restrictions. The government's reply accepts many points, adapts the bill (e.g. document definition, archivist reporting line, transfer definition) and explains why others, such as the Ministry of BZK co-signature and the proactive lifting of restrictions, are not adopted.
concerns: Advised to clarify and motivate the differences between the document definition in the bill and the Woo; the government adjusted the definition and removed the restrictive criterion.
Advised to clarify the vague phrase 'zoveel mogelijk overeenkomstig de bepalingen van deze wet' for joint arrangements of cooperation partnerships; the phrase was deleted.

Advised to address practical feasibility of digital preservation and networks/algorithms; the government pointed to the general framework and implementing regulations but gave limited concrete changes.
Concern that expanded possibilities to restrict openness after transfer risk unjustified secrecy; the government justified it but declined the advice to oblige proactive lifting of restrictions.

Advised that the position of the archivist be strengthened (direct reporting, separation of functions, diploma requirement); the government added direct reporting and biennial reporting but kept the diploma change.
Advised co-signature by the Minister of BZK; the government declined, citing its own responsibilities for the Archiefwet.

35995.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate by means of an incidental supplementary budget, mainly for a support package in the first quarter of 2022 and a turnover-loss scheme for water damage in Limburg. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect from 1 January 2022 with retroactive effect.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) for the year 2022
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) voor het jaar 2022

36100-VII.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget statement (Slotwet) of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and of its agencies, adjusting appropriations and realised figures against the budget as set. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.

De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36350-IX.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2023 budget statements of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA), adjusting appropriations, revenues and commitments in thousands of euros, effective from 1 June 2023. The explanatory memorandum explains the main mutations, including tax revenue adjustments and additional child-benefit (toeslagen) recovery costs.
36350-IX.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by the need to adjust appropriations, citing Hersteloperatie Toeslagen costs and an autonomous budget shortfall in the child benefit scheme.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IX) for the year 2023
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IX), voor het jaar 2023

36499.s: The bill amends the 2024 departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) by an incidental supplementary budget of EUR 1.947 billion for the Ukraine Facility, adding commitments under article 4 (international financial relations). It takes retroactive effect from 1 February 2024 and contains no delegation of rule-making power.

36550-IV.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2024 budget statements for Kingdom Relations and the BES-fund, shifting funds for border security, criminal investigation, judiciary, slavery-past programmes and other items. It does not delegate rule-making power or alter oversight arrangements, and it takes effect retroactively from 1 June 2024.
q: The 2024 budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) is amended, as shown in the statement belonging to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36550-VI.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget and agency budget statements of the Ministry of Justice and Security, mainly adding funds to policing, legal aid, migration and detention while shifting some money between items. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive discretion and no changes to oversight or review bodies.
q: We, William-Alexander, by the grace of God, King of the Netherlands, Prince of Orange-Nassau, etc. etc. etc.
Wij Willem-Alexander, bij de gratie Gods, Koning der Nederlanden, Prins van Oranje-Nassau, enz. enz. enz.

36613-IV.s: The bill amends the 2024 budget statements for Kingdom Relations (IV) and the BES Fund (H) by reallocating and increasing appropriations, including a provisional up-to-66 million euro loan facility for Sint Maarten and reconstruction funding. It makes the changes effective retroactively from 11 September 2024 and contains no delegation of rule-making power.
q: With the September supplementary budget, financial room is reserved in the budget should the Netherlands, on the basis of the so-called ongoing registration in the Kingdom Act on financial supervision, grant an annuity loan of 66 million euros to Sint Maarten.

Met de suppletoire begroting september wordt er financiële ruimte gereserveerd in de begroting, mocht Nederland, op basis van de in de Rijkswet financieel toezicht opgenomen zogenaamde lopende inschrijving, een annuïtaire lening ter grootte van € 66 mln.

36613-VI.s: The bill amends the departmental budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security for 2024 through a supplementary budget, shifting appropriations across policy articles such as police, judiciary, migration and contraterrorism. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and gives the amended budget retroactive effect to 17 September 2024.
36613-VI.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to shortfalls and cost increases such as wage and price adjustments and occupational health complaints, with no new executive powers claimed.
q: In addition, € 6 million is transferred to the police to partially compensate for a setback in the area of work-related health complaints.
Daarnaast worden € 6 mln. overgeheveld naar de politie ter gedeeltelijke compensatie van een tegenvaller op het gebied van beroepsgerelateerde gezondheidsklachten

36679.s: The bill amends article 19(7) of the Health Insurance Act so that the mandatory deductible (eigen risico) for health insurance stays at €385 for 2026, extending the existing fixed amount that previously covered 2019 through 2025. It enters into force on a date set by royal decree.
q: In article 19(7) of the Health Insurance Act, 'for the years 2019 through 2025' is replaced by 'for the years 2019 through 2026'.
In artikel 19, zevende lid, van de Zorgverzekeringswet wordt «voor de jaren 2019 tot en met 2025» vervangen door «voor de jaren 2019 tot en met 2026».

parties: Has taken note of the freeze and has no questions or comments at this stage.
The PVV members have taken note of the amendment to the Health Insurance Act to keep the mandatory deductible unchanged in 2026 and currently have no questions or comments on it.

De leden van de PVV-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van de wijziging van de Zorgverzekeringswet teneinde het verplicht eigen risico voor de zorgverzekering in 2026 ongewijzigd te laten en hebben hierover momenteel geen vragen en/of opmerkingen.
Worries about rising costs for care users and premium payers, questions broken promises to abolish the deductible, and asks for firm guarantees that the 2027 reduction will not be postponed further.
Can the government guarantee that the reduction of the deductible takes effect in 2027 and is not postponed any further?
Kan de regering garanderen dat de verlaging van het eigen risico in 2027 ingaat en niet nog verder wordt uitgesteld?
Supports tranching the deductible at 50 euro per treatment from 2027 and backs the freeze until then, with only a single question.
The said members are in favour of the proposal to tranche the deductible at fifty euro per treatment from 2027.
Genoemde leden zijn voorstander van het voorstel om per 2027 het eigen risico te trancheren op een bedrag van vijftig euro per behandelprestatie.
Supports the direction but asks how the effects on care demand will be monitored so the government can adjust quickly, and raises the risk that the European Commission may reject the reduction.
How is the effect of both measures on care demand monitored, so that it can be quickly adjusted if care use increases or undesired care avoidance is observed?
Hoe wordt het effect van beide maatregelen op de zorgvraag gemonitord, zodat er snel bijgestuurd kan worden indien gewenst zorggebruik toeneemt of juist ongewenste zorgmijding wordt waargenomen?
Considers halving the deductible in 2027 unwise, fearing overburdened care and higher premiums, and asks why the earlier tranching bill was withdrawn and for a clear timeline.
Why has the government chosen to cancel this bill, these members ask.
Waarom heeft de regering ervoor gekozen om dit wetsvoorstel te annuleren, zo vragen deze leden?
Has taken note of the bill and has no questions for the government at present.
They currently have no questions for the government.
Zij hebben momenteel geen vragen aan de regering.
Asks for quantified effects on care avoidance, waiting times, real value of the deductible since 2016, and projected deductible levels to 2040.
These members ask whether the government can quantify or estimate how much more care avoidance there would be if the mandatory deductible were indexed in 2026.
Deze leden vragen of de regering kan kwantificeren of een inschatting kan maken hoeveel meer zorgmijding er zou zijn als het verplicht eigen risico in 2026 wel zou worden geïndexeerd.

Argues the deductible is a fine on being ill and should be abolished, questions the government's commitment to accessibility and solidarity, and asks for reasoning behind the 165 euro level and the European Commission's position.
The deductible is a fine for being ill, therefore the deductible should be abolished entirely.
Het eigen risico is een boete op ziek zijn daarom zou het eigen risico helemaal afgeschaft moeten worden.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a government bill to keep the mandatory deductible (verplicht eigen risico) in health insurance unchanged in 2026, and raised no remarks. The minister's reply notes only minor editorial corrections to the explanatory memorandum and sends the bill to the Tweede Kamer.

36725-III.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget statements for the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA), the Cabinet of the King (IIIB), and the Oversight Committee on the Intelligence and Security Services (IIIC), plus the agency statement, with a first supplementary budget. It mainly adjusts appropriations for communication and policy coordination, wage and price adjustments, and reverses a staffing cut for the CTIVD.

36787.s: The bill amends the 2025 budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) through an incidental supplementary budget for business support, changing spending and revenue lines by thousands of euros. It sets the entry-into-force date as 8 July of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) for the year 2025
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds (K) voor het jaar 2025

36796.s: This omnibus bill makes numerous technical and minor policy amendments across Social Affairs and Employment legislation, including replacing outdated terminology about institutions, transferring information-bureau references, and adjusting the Arbeidsomstandighedenwet consultation rules. It also gives the Minister a statutory basis for a specific grant to border information points and makes related procedural changes.
36796.j: The memorandum justifies the grant regulation as needed for timely payment in 2024 and the need to create a statutory basis after using an urgent ministerial regulation.
d: rules for Bureau Informatiediensten Nederland tasks, financing and management
amount, distribution and accountability of specific grant to border info points
p: Minister may grant and recover a specific grant to Rijksontvangers, with amounts set by ministerial regulation and subject to accountability duties.
Removes the requirement that changed child-benefit amounts be announced in the Staatscourant and deletes related provisions, reducing publication transparency.

parties: Asks why the government did not choose the alternative harmonisation option and what budgetary effects follow, and why article 12 is not more concrete given the NLA's criticism.
These members ask for further justification of why the government does not choose the second option.
Deze leden vragen nader te onderbouwen waarom de regering niet kiest voor de tweede optie.

Supports the renaming but asks how Parliament will be involved in the statute change, and asks the government to respond to a critical report recommending conversion into a zbo for transparency and warning against municipal dependence and monopoly risks.
These members ask whether the government can indicate how and when the House of Representatives will be involved in this statute amendment.
Deze leden vragen of de regering aan kan geven hoe en wanneer de Tweede Kamer betrokken zal worden bij deze statutenwijziging.
Has no questions on the bill.
The members of the D66 faction have taken note of the bill with interest and have no questions.
De leden van de D66-fractie hebben met interesse kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben geen vragen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that an omnibus (Verzamelwet) bill amending social affairs laws should not include a new offence and maximum penalty for the Wao BES tegemoetkoming, and that the Arbowet should give all workers or their representatives a right to make safety proposals; the government reply accepted both points and amended the bill, adding a correction to Participatiewet article 62 and other technical fixes.
concerns: Creating a new offence and maximum penalty for failing the information duty for the tegemoetkoming requires substantive justification and does not fit a technical omnibus bill, so the reference to articles 44, 47 and 52 Wao BES was dropped.
The Arbowet implementation of the framework directive is incomplete because workers or their representatives lack a right to make proposals on safety and health, which the bill is amended to provide.

36800-IX.s: This is the 2026 budget bill for the Ministry of Finance (chapter IXB) and the National Debt (IXA), fixing spending, commitments and revenue estimates in thousands of euros and setting entry into force. The explanatory memorandum describes budget policy priorities, Tax Administration and Customs operations, financial market supervision, state participations, guarantees and the VAT compensation fund.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2026 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2026 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the 2026 budget bill for the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA) and advises submitting it to the House of Representatives. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport sets out technical updates to the figures (CPB projections, tax revenues, dividend estimate) without responding to any legal concerns.

36820-IV.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget statements for the Ministry of Kingdom Relations (IV) and the BES-fonds (H) in a September supplementary budget, shifting appropriations among policy articles such as the rule of law, Sint Maarten and Curaçao loans, and the unallocated reserve. It does not delegate rule-making power or alter oversight arrangements.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Kingdom Relations (IV) and the budget statement of the BES-fonds (H) for the year 2025.
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) en de begrotingsstaat van het BES-fonds (H) voor het jaar 2025.

36820-VI.s: This bill amends the 2025 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Justice and Security and the budgets of its agencies, through the September supplementary budget, with retroactive effect to 16 September 2025. It sets budget amounts across policy articles such as police, justice administration, criminal enforcement and integration, without delegating rule-making power.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security for the year 2025
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid voor het jaar 2025

36859.s: The bill makes permanent the national power to take and process biometric data (facial images and fingerprints) of foreigners, which would otherwise lapse on 1 March 2026 under the horizon clause of article 115 of the Vreemdelingenwet 2000. It also codifies the conditions under which facial images of foreigners may be provided for criminal investigation and prosecution, and requires a report to parliament within three years on processing and destruction of biometric data.
36859.j: The memorandum justifies permanence by the need for reliable identity verification in national admission procedures not covered by EU regulations, combined with fraud prevention and national security, and by the findings of three evaluations.
q: This bill therefore serves to permanently confirm the powers under the Wbvk.
Dit wetsvoorstel voorziet daarom in de definitieve bevestiging van de bevoegdheden uit de Wbvk.
p: Extends the existing conditions for providing fingerprints of foreigners for criminal investigation to facial images, requiring a written authorisation from the investigating judge on the prosecutor's request.
Artikel I, onderdeel B (article 115 Vw 2000 repealed)
Removes the sunset horizon so the executive's power to collect and retain biometric data of foreigners continues indefinitely, with only a single report to parliament required.

parties: Asks how duplicate or inconsistent registrations between national and EU databases will be prevented, and whether the rules on police use of CATCH data will be made more effective.
How will implementation prevent duplicate or inconsistent registrations being taken between national registers and European databases?
Hoe wordt in de uitvoering voorkomen dat er dubbele of inconsistente registraties worden afgenomen tussen nationale registers en Europese databases?

Asks why police access to facial images for prosecution lacked the additional conditions applied to fingerprints, and asks the government for an overview of measures ensuring careful handling of biometric data.
The CDA members share the government's view that biometric data of foreigners must be handled carefully.
De leden van de CDA-fractie delen de mening van de regering dat het belangrijk is dat op een zorgvuldige wijze wordt omgegaan met biometrische gegevens van vreemdelingen.

Asks when and how biometric data is destroyed, how long it is retained, how often police access to CATCH is used, and whether a rechter-commissaris must authorise requests; also asks how the database is protected against hacking.
The JA21 members ask how many people's data are in the CATCH database and when it is removed from there.
De leden van de JA21-fractie vragen van hoeveel mensen data in de CATCH-database staan en wanneer die daaruit worden verwijderd.

Supports the bill as essential for identity fraud prevention and public order, stresses statutory safeguards on privacy, and asks whether police can link asylum seekers' data to police systems to act against nuisance.
The right to privacy is a fundamental right, the BBB members note.
Het recht op privacy is een fundamenteel recht, zo constateren de leden van de BBB-fractie.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill to make permanent the national power to take and process biometric data of foreigners by deleting its sunset clause, raising objections on necessity given EU regulations, the legal basis and retention rules for the CATCH-vreemdelingen system, and the conditions for police use of facial images. The Minister's reply accepts most advice, adding an evaluation clause and conditions for facial image use, while saying the CATCH system review is only being explored.
concerns: The national power to process biometric data must be justified in light of existing EU regulations such as Eurodac and VIS, and the bill adapted if needed.
The legal basis, necessity and retention periods for storing facial images in CATCH-vreemdelingen are unclear and must be regulated by law or the processing changed or stopped.
Copying facial images of all foreigners into CATCH without differentiation conflicts with the principle of minimal data processing.
Conditions applying to fingerprint use for criminal investigation should also be legally set for use of facial images for that purpose.
Biometric data are not always destroyed in time, so the memorandum should explain measures to prevent unlawful retention and an evaluation clause should be added.

36868.s: The bill amends the Dutch Wet uitvoering EU-handelingen energie-efficiëntie, Energiewet, Warmtewet and the draft Wet collectieve warmte to implement EU Directive 2023/1791 on energy efficiency. It adds energy-efficiency-first obligations, energy management and audit duties for firms, a 1.9% public-sector energy-saving obligation, and sustainability plans and fossil-fuel restrictions for heat networks.
36868.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly as necessary to implement the directive's thresholds, deadlines and technical requirements, to be set in general administrative orders that take effect with the bill.
q: These financial threshold values will be laid down in regulations at the level of a general administrative order.
Deze financiële drempelwaarden zullen op het niveau vaneen algemene maatregel van bestuur in regelgeving worden vastgelegd.
d: Wet uitvoering EU-handelingen energie-efficiëntie art. 9, lid 3
Wet uitvoering EU-handelingen energie-efficiëntie art. 9a, lid 1 (threshold)
thresholds for energy-efficiency-first in planning and investment decisions
Wet uitvoering EU-handelingen energie-efficiëntie art. 18, lid 5
rules on energy use measurement, energy audits, energy management and exemptions
Wet uitvoering EU-handelingen energie-efficiëntie art. 18, lid 4
date by which audit reports must be sent to the Minister
Wet uitvoering EU-handelingen energie-efficiëntie art. 18b, lid 4 and 5
which public bodies are covered; plan and reporting requirements; distribution of savings
Wet uitvoering EU-handelingen energie-efficiëntie art. 23, lid 1 and 2
officials designated by ministerial decision to supervise and enforce
measures and monitoring of system losses
Energiewet art. 5.1, lid 3 (nieuw, delegation for ACM tasks)
additional tasks for the ACM under directive 2023/1791 and annual report content
content and submission of sustainability plans for heat networks
obligations on fossil fuel use for new heat sources and renovated networks
obligations on fossil fuel use and emission standards for collective heat supply
p: Wet uitvoering EU-handelingen energie-efficiëntie art. 23, lid 4 (nieuw)
The Minister may use information collected for policy purposes in supervising compliance with the audit and reporting duties, widening data use beyond the original purpose.
Wet uitvoering EU-handelingen energie-efficiëntie art. 23, lid 1-3
Enforcement and supervision powers are assigned to ministerially designated civil servants, published in the Staatscourant.
The ACM must approve or order amendment of sustainability plans for large heat networks, a supervisory role for the regulator.

parties: Questions whether the raised threshold conflicts with EU targets and asks for implementation of the energy-efficiency-first principle per sector, citing the Raad van State's advice that the implementation falls short.
These members note that the Council of State's advisory division states that correct and adequate implementation of this principle requires measures going beyond the present bill.

Deze leden constateren dat de Afderling advisering van de Raad van State stelt dat correcte en adequate implementatie van dit beginsel maatregelen vereist die verder gaan dan het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.
Asks how exempting about 40,000 firms fits the climate and energy-saving goals and raises the enforcement expertise warning from the VNG.

Can the government also reflect on the warning from the Association of Dutch Municipalities (VNG) that the expertise of enforcement officers specialised in firms to be exempted must be discarded and is difficult to rebuild?

Kan de regering ook reflecteren op de waarschuwing van de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) dat de deskundigheid van handhavers die zijn gespecialiseerd in bedrijven die gevrijwaard gaan worden moet worden afgestoten en moeilijk opnieuw op te bouwen is?
Asks practical questions on applying the energy-efficiency-first principle and progress toward energy-saving targets.
These questions mainly concern the practical application of the energy-efficiency-first principle and progress on energy-saving targets.
Deze vragen gaan voornamelijk over de praktische toepassing van het energie-efficiëntie-eerstbeginsel en de voortgang op energiebesparingsdoelen.

Asks that key thresholds and sector designations be fixed in the statute rather than lower regulation, so that parliamentary control and legal certainty are guaranteed, and asks for timely draft lower regulation.
They request the government to answer their questions concretely and verifiably and to send draft lower regulation in time, so that control by the House and feasibility are assured.

Zij verzoeken de regering de door hen hieronder gesteld vragen concreet en controleerbaar te beantwoorden en tijdig concept-lagere regelgeving te sturen, zodat controle door de Kamer en de uitvoerbaarheid geborgd zijn.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the draft bill implementing the recast EU Energy Efficiency Directive (EED), raising concerns that the Netherlands' indicative energy-saving targets may not be achieved, that the energy-efficiency-first principle requires further measures and enforcement, that the public procurement provision should be placed in the Aanbestedingswet 2012, and that the district heating sustainability criteria and sustainability plans need clarification and adjustment. The Minister's reply accepted most points, amending the explanatory memorandum, adding sustainability criteria to the Wcw via a new Article IV, and explaining why an implementation obligation for sustainability plans was not imposed, while keeping procurement implementation in the WiEU.
concerns: Advice that it is insufficiently clear the EED is adequately implemented and that the Netherlands' energy-saving targets will be achieved; the memorandum was expanded but the government acknowledged the targets are ambitious and the effect is hard to quantify.

Advice that the energy-efficiency-first principle requires measures beyond the bill and that enforcement and supporting provisions must be specified; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented with implementing decree plans and a guidance handbook.
Advice to implement the procurement provision (Article 7 EED) in the Aanbestedingswet 2012 rather than the WiEU; the government kept it in the WiEU, arguing it concerns pre-procurement decisions.

Advice to add sustainability criteria for efficient district heating and cooling systems to the Wcw applicable from the dates required by the EED; followed via a new Article IV inserting paragraph 2.5.5a into the Wcw.

Advice to justify in the explanatory memorandum why there is no obligation to implement sustainability plans for heating networks; the government added justification but did not impose an implementation duty.

36886.s: The bill amends the Housing Act to replace the market value (actuele waarde) with the policy value (beleidswaarde) as the valuation basis for housing corporations' annual accounts, removing the obligation to report market value in the financial statements. It also sets transitional exemptions for restating comparative figures for certain property and provision items.
36886.j: The memorandum justifies the change by reducing administrative burdens and audit uncertainty, and states that supervisory and guarantee tools remain unchanged; the delegation was narrowed on Council of State advice so that the policy-value basis is fixed in the law itself.
q: Partly on the basis of this advice, and the advice of the Council of State's Advisory Division, the delegation basis has been limited so that the law itself provides that valuation takes place at policy value.

Mede naar aanleiding van dit advies, en het advies van de Afdeling Advisering van de Raad van State, is de delegatiegrondslag beperkt zodat op het niveau van de wet is geregeld dat de waardering tegen de beleidswaarde plaatsvindt.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel C (artikel 35, tweede lid Woningwet)
valuation rules for corporation real estate at policy value

parties: No questions raised; the fractie waives asking questions at this stage.
The members of the D66 faction have taken note of the bill and at this time refrain from asking questions.
De leden van de D66-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en zij zien op dit moment af van het stellen van vragen.

Asks whether the central valuation method could bring new reporting obligations or extra supervision, whether savings are guaranteed, and whether an independent baseline and evaluation will be included.
They also ask whether an independent baseline measurement and evaluation will be built in to test the actual savings.
Ook vragen zij of er een onafhankelijke nulmeting en evaluatie wordt ingepast om de werkelijke besparing te toetsen.

Concerned about consistency and comparability of policy value across corporations, the lack of statutory anchoring of the central valuation method, and the democratic control and transparency of its assumptions.

These members ask how the governance of this central methodology is arranged, now that it is not anchored in law, and how transparency and democratic control are ensured regarding the assumptions, models and any adjustments.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen hoe de governance van deze centrale methodiek is ingericht, nu deze niet wettelijk wordt verankerd, en hoe transparantie en democratische controle worden geborgd ten aanzien van de gehanteerde aannames, modellen en eventuele aanpassingen daarvan.

Asks what practical solutions the Aw will provide for small non-WSW corporations, the pending Aw research, the effect of a lower policy value on solvency and borrowing capacity, and who is ultimately responsible under the new supervisory framework.

Who is ultimately responsible when the financial continuity of a corporation is at risk under the new supervisory framework, and how is it prevented that responsibilities between the Aw and the WSW become diffuse?

Wie is uiteindelijk eindverantwoordelijk wanneer de financiële continuïteit van een corporatie in gevaar komt onder het nieuwe toezichtkader, en hoe wordt voorkomen dat verantwoordelijkheden tussen de Aw en het WSW diffuus worden?
Has no further questions on the bill.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the valuation basis for housing corporations' property (beleidswaarde instead of actuele waarde) must be laid down in the statute rather than delegated to lower regulation, since it is a main element. The minister's reply states the advice was followed and the bill amended so that the delegation in article 35(2) Woningwet is limited to beleidswaarde-based rules.
concerns: The valuation basis (beleidswaarde) is a main element that must be fixed in the statute, not left to an AMvB, so the delegation must be restricted.

36949.s: The bill amends the Dutch Equal Treatment of Men and Women Act (Wgbmv) and related laws to implement EU Directive 2023/970 on pay transparency, requiring employers to disclose pay information, report gender pay gaps, and conduct pay evaluations. It also introduces administrative enforcement tools (orders, warnings, penalties) for the Labour Inspectorate and assigns monitoring duties to the Minister of Social Affairs.
36949.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed for technical detail in the new pay reporting system and for consistent implementation of the EU directive.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative measure, further rules are set regarding this reporting obligation.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur worden nadere regels gesteld met betrekking tot deze rapportageverplichting
d: further definitions of pay concepts such as basic pay, gross pay and pay gap
rules on pay gap reporting obligation and electronic submission
date by which employers must first submit pay information
policy rules on written warnings and penalty orders
policy rules fixing administrative fine amounts
rules on publication of enforcement outcomes
Artikel II (art. 12b lid 5 Wet allocatie arbeidskrachten)
model for information exchange set by collective agreement or ministerial regulation
p: Gives officials designated by the Minister power to impose compliance orders, warnings, penalty orders and administrative fines on employers without prior judicial involvement.
Allows officials to publicly name employers subject to enforcement measures, with a waiting period and suspension during interim relief proceedings.
Allows fair valuation of work by the employer where no job evaluation system exists, which may leave room for employer judgement.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Dutch bill implementing EU Pay Transparency Directive 2023/970, raising concerns about cost-effectiveness, the missed transposition deadline, the first reporting date set later than the directive requires, the monitoring body designation, sex registration and personal data protection. The government's reply largely accepts the points on the monitoring body and data protection and adds clarifications, but keeps the later first reporting date for employers with 150+ employees and does not adopt the proposed alternative of state-generated reports.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned the cost-effectiveness of the measures and the lack of a realistic assessment of effectiveness, and asked why the state-generated report option was not used; the government clarified but did not adopt the alternative.

The Afdeling said the later first reporting date for employers with 150+ employees is contrary to the directive's explicit deadline of 7 June 2027, and asked for it to be aligned; the government kept the later date as unfeasible.
The Afdeling asked for certainty on whether the monitoring body (DSU) can perform its tasks; the government designated the Minister of SZW in the bill (art. 10e) as advised.

The Afdeling asked for safeguards and a clear legal basis for processing personal data and limiting use of traceable individual pay data; the government added a provision (art. 10f, second paragraph) and clarified the legal basis.
The Afdeling asked for clarity on how non-binary persons must be treated in pay reporting; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented accordingly.

The Afdeling asked for explanation of consequences of exceeding the implementation deadline; the government added this to the explanatory memorandum, including direct effect and state liability discussion.
